nodes.label: PostgreSQL
detail: WORKING ASSUMPTION (spine C3); dev/CI embedded or containerized, ephemeral-only (D1, M40). Schemas: conversion-state · lineage (append-only: app role INSERT/SELECT only, per-conversion hash chain, supersede-not-update — ADR 0012) · outbox+queue (bounded retries, dead-letter quarantine — M21) · judge-response cache (M27, CF7). No cross-lifecycle foreign keys (F4, ADR 0006)

nodes.label: object storage
detail: Evidence object storage behind an S3-compatible port (ADR 0011). Dev/CI: containerized MinIO; production BINDING PROBE-PENDING (week-0 platform probe; default = self-operated MinIO). Write-once / object-lock REQUIRED — ADR 0012's precondition, deployment-checked. Holds: classified artifacts + retention classes (M39) · canonicalized source snapshots (M15) · lineage chain anchors (ADR 0012). Envelope encryption + crypto-shredding before the first audit-retained artifact (ADR 0011 as amended)
